ttm.shares_basis: latest quarter's diluted weighted-average count (not all four quarters filed)

dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2009-07-04..2026-07-04; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2009-01-03..2009-01-03, 1 facts); paid FY facts for 2 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no declared FY fact and no four declared quarterly facts (2010-01-02, 2011-01-01); the declared tag files quarterly facts in the last 8 quarters ending 2026-07-04, the paid tag only full-year facts — the quarterly tag is primary (the paid tag's full-year facts fill only fiscal years the declared tag does not cover)
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2024-12-29..2026-01-03) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: the year most of each fiscal year falls in — two fiscal years end in the same calendar year; join on period_end, not the label
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-27..2026-07-04
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-27..2026-07-04
notes: dps_basis: declared facts for periods ending 2009-07-04..2026-07-04; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2009-01-03..2009-01-03, 1 facts); paid FY facts for 2 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no declared FY fact and no four declared quarterly facts (2010-01-02, 2011-01-01) — the series switches basis where one tag stops; the switch year can double-count or skip one payment (a dividend declared in one quarter and paid in the next)

annual_dps labels: FY2020 here (period ended 2021-01-02) is labelled FY2021 in the annual / quarterly tables; FY2021 here (period ended 2022-01-01) is labelled FY2022 in the annual / quarterly tables; FY2025 here (period ended 2026-01-03) is labelled FY2026 in the annual / quarterly tables — two fiscal years end in the same calendar year (a 53-week year or a fiscal-year-end change); join on period_end

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (189 days between 2025-09-27 and 2026-04-04) — FY2025 DPS 8.86 + the quarters since (2026-04-04: 2.44, 2026-07-04: 2.44) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-29: 2.14, 2025-06-28: 2.14)

warnings: revenue basis: the filer's own total (Revenues / RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense) for every period — it exceeds the contract-revenue line, which is a component for this filer
